title: Elite: Bind the Storm-Oath Bridge: Forward Claim
description: Elite: Bind the Storm-Oath Bridge: Forward Claim is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through The Thunder-Oath Gate (Ruin Gate with active oath memory). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Odin, Freyja, Skadi, Thor enters; this beat spotlights Skadi as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the combat step at Storm-Oath Bridge, using storm bridge and world-root trial pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Storm-Oath Bridge and reveals: A damaged inscription showing the Gate can bind gods as well as monsters. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Earth — Ancient Greece, Aegean Coast. white-stone cliffs above turquoise sea, ancient harbors with trireme wrecks, olive groves cracking under Gate-pressure, coastal temples split by void-fissures. Elite Hollow encounter in the avatar's mythological homeland, ancient era.

objectives.primary: With one selected deity, break the first enemy pressure line in the elite-tuned Storm-Oath Bridge, secure the outer defense, and deny the Hollow a foothold in the outer dungeon.
optional: Clear the Storm-Oath Bridge without the active deity falling below 35% integrity
Exploit or avoid the route rule: world-root snare paths that remember old betrayals
Resolve at least three oath law, storm timing, world-root control, courage under blackwinter pressure decisions before victory
Finish with the boss, elite, shrine, treasure, or hazard node clearly readable for mobile tactical play

specialRules: Route Law — Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet: Ruin Gate with active oath memory changes how movement, hazards, and enemy pressure are read.
Room Rule — Storm-Oath Bridge: play this beat as a combat node, not a generic arena.
Solo Divine Scale: one player-controlled Avatar occupies the tactical focus; enemy numbers and boss pressure scale around that single presence.
victoryConditions: With one selected deity, break the first enemy pressure line in the elite-tuned Storm-Oath Bridge, secure the outer defense, and deny the Hollow a foothold in the outer dungeon.
